The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

definitions.full: H584. anach [ אָנַח ] verb only Niph`al sigh, groan , mostly in poetry & late (Aramaic אֲנַח , Ethpe`el compare Assyrian [ anâ—u ], inh—u , sigh Zim BP 12, 30 ) — Perfect 3feminine singular נֶאֶנְחָה Lam 1:8 ; Joel 1:18 ; 3 plural נֶאֶנְחוּ Isa 24:7 ; Imperfect יֵאָנַח Prov 29:2 etc.; Imperative הֵאָנַ֯ח֑ Ezek 21:11 ; Participle נֶאְנָ֑ךְ 21:12 ; נֶאֱנָחָה Lam 1:21 etc.; — 1 sigh , in token of grief Isa 24:7 ; Prov 29:2 ; Lam 1:4 (|| נוּגוֺתּ ) 1:21 ; Ezek 21:11 (twice in verse); of Jerusalem Lam 1:8 ; mostly absolute but followed by אַלֿ Ezek 9:4 (|| נֶאֱנָק ); followed by עַלֿ & אֱלֿ 21:12 . 2 in physical distress Lam 1:11 (|| לֶחֶם בִּקֵּשׁ ); Exod 2:23 followed by מִן by reason of (|| זָעַק ). 3 groan of cattle ( בְּהֵמָה ) Joel 1:18 .
